title: QUICK_REFERENCE.md's command and layout sections are dead: `pnpm typecheck` is not a script, all three `example-*` dev commands name packages that do not exist, and `apps/server` is not in the tree
body:
Out-of-scope finding from #4143. That card's ruling scoped its PR to the "Current Release" block (which it repaired and pinned). The rot is not confined to that block, and the rest is a **worse** class: #4143's own body argued the file was observation-class because "no copy-pasteable instruction is wrong". On this tree, four of them are.

Verified on `origin/main` = `d86d372ad`, each with the command actually run.

## 1. `pnpm typecheck` does not exist (line 12)

Documented under **Install & Build** as "Run tsc --noEmit across the workspace":

```
$ pnpm typecheck
 ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL  Command "typecheck" not found

Did you mean "pnpm type-check"?
```

The root manifest declares `type-check`, `type-check:coverage`, `type-check:scripts` and `type-check:vitest-setup`. There has never been a `typecheck`. pnpm's own suggestion is the fix.

## 2. All three "Run Examples" commands name packages that do not exist (lines 55-59)

```
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/example-crm dev
No projects matched the filters in "/home/user/objectui-issue-4143"
```

Same for `@object-ui/example-todo` and `@object-ui/example-kitchen-sink`. `examples/` contains `byo-backend-console`, `console-starter`, `hello-world` and `schema-catalog` — not one of the three the section tells you to run. A reader following this section gets nothing runnable at all.

## 3. `apps/server` is not in the tree (line 76)

The **Repository Layout** table lists `apps/server` as "Vercel backend for `demo.objectstack.ai`". `apps/` contains `console` and `site`.

The same table's `examples/*` row also describes the set as "CRM, todo, byo-backend-console, console-starter" — the first two are the packages from item 2, gone; `hello-world` and `schema-catalog` are present and unmentioned.

## 4. Minor, in the same table: "39 published packages" (line 73)

`packages/` holds 39 directories, but one of them (`packages/vscode-extension`, package name `object-ui`) is `private: true`. 38 are published to npm. Off by one in the direction that overstates.

## Why this is a separate card

#4143 is closed by repairing and pinning one block. These are a different section, a different failure (a command that errors, not a number that misleads), and the fix needs someone to decide what the examples section should say now — which examples are the ones a newcomer should run, and whether `hello-world`/`schema-catalog` want dev commands documented. That is a judgement call, not a value swap.

Note for whoever takes it: the pin added by #4143 covers the "Current Release" block only, and deliberately so — it derives every expected value from a manifest, and a command name has no manifest anchor of that kind. Pinning section 1 is cheap all the same (root `package.json` `scripts` is a perfectly good anchor for "every `pnpm foo` this page documents exists"); sections 2-4 would want a workspace-membership check.

## Searched for duplicates

`QUICK_REFERENCE`, `pnpm typecheck`, `example-crm`, `apps/server` over open issues in this repo: only #4143 itself, which covers the "Current Release" block and no other part of the file.
